title: etzhayyim docs registry (docs.json)
description: Schema for 90-docs/_registry/docs.json — the machine-readable sidecar index regenerated from canonical EDN documents and descriptive Markdown. This schema describes the normalized JSON shape used by downstream consumers and drift checks.

status.description: Governance-evolving status field. Common values include: active / proposed / accepted / deprecated / superseded. ADR-specific values may appear (e.g. proposed-pending-council-ratification, implemented, draft, deferred). Schema is permissive on this field while data normalization is governance-bounded; future schema tightening requires Council Lv6+ ≥3.

doc_type.description: Open document classification. Legacy keyword spellings are retained until their source record is normalized.

topic.description: Optional classification topic; empty when a legacy document has not yet been classified.

depends_on.description: ADR depends_on chain — list of doc-id references. Cycle 64 surfaced this previously-unindexed frontmatter field.

last_verified.description: Verification date. New records use ISO 8601; the registry also preserves legacy EDN inst rendering until its source is normalized.
